body.name: Joint OVS score vector
body.construction: For \(k=(g,t)\in\mathcal K\) and \(c\in\mathcal J_k\), let \(e_{a,s,k}(O)=\sum_{u=g}^t\{\Delta Y_u-m_{a,s,u}(X)\}\). Define the observed-law score \[R_{k,c,P}(O)=\frac{1}{\pi_{g,1}}\Bigg[\mathbf 1\{G=g,S=1\}\{q_{k,c}(X)+e_{g,1,k}(O)\}-\frac{p_{g,1}(X)}{p_{g,0}(X)}\mathbf 1\{G=g,S=0\}e_{g,0,k}(O)\] \[{}-\frac{p_{g,1}(X)}{p_{c,1}(X)}\mathbf 1\{G=c,S=1\}e_{c,1,k}(O)+\frac{p_{g,1}(X)}{p_{c,0}(X)}\mathbf 1\{G=c,S=0\}e_{c,0,k}(O)\Bigg],\qquad \Psi_{k,c,P}(O)=R_{k,c,P}(O)-\theta_k(P).\] Stack the coordinates in the fixed order \(\mathcal I\).
